title: RTPS: fix malformed packet on encrypted user-data payload
description:
When "Enable User Data Dissection" is on and a topic uses
data_protection_kind=ENCRYPT with metadata_protection_kind=NONE,
the DATA submessage header is in plaintext but the serialized payload
is a CryptoContent blob. The dissector looked up the discovered type,
tried to parse the encrypted bytes as CDR, read a garbage string
length, and threw a ReportedBoundsError that surfaced as a malformed
packet error.

Three changes to rtps_util_try_dissector:

1. Add a payload_size parameter and create a bounded sub-tvb
   (tvb_new_subset_length) before calling dissect_user_defined, so
   reads cannot stray past the serialized data region. The same bound
   is applied to the dissector-table path that previously used
   tvb_new_subset_remaining.

2. Wrap dissect_user_defined in TRY/CATCH_NONFATAL_ERRORS. On
   exception add a PI_WARN expert info
   (rtps.user_data_dissection_error) instead of propagating the
   error as a malformed packet.

3. Guard against payload_size <= 0 (DISPOSE batch samples, truncated
   packets) and return false immediately.

Call sites updated: dissect_serialized_data computes payload_size as
the total data size minus the encapsulation header bytes consumed
(with a special case for decompressed payloads), and
dissect_RTPS_DATA_BATCH passes sample_info_length[count].

AI-Assisted: yes (Copilot)

notes.body:
[domain4.pcapng](/uploads/e00623bb100bab462308ffd837b69029/domain4.pcapng)
[demo_governance.xml](/uploads/51edd4e1e0ce855bfbc85b8dafb120d1/demo_governance.xml)
For context, demo_governance.xml shows that domain 4 sets data_protection_kind=ENCRYPT for the Triangle topic -- Wireshark does not read this file, it's reference material explaining the capture.

Enable the preference rtps.enable_user_data_dissection (off by default).

- Filter _ws.malformed -- zero matches (was 99 before fix)
- Filter rtps.user_data_dissection_error -- 99 matches, all Triangle DATA frames
- Frame 1512 (encrypted Triangle DATA): serializedData shows [Expert Info (Warning/Protocol): User data dissection failed: payload may be encrypted] instead of [Malformed Packet: RTPS]. The SRTPS_POSTFIX submessage following it is now properly dissected (was hidden by the malformed error).
- Frame 957 (unencrypted Square DATA, same capture): still dissects correctly -- color: BLUE, x: 197, y: 136, shapesize: 30, fillKind: 0, angle: 0.000000. Confirms no regression for non-encrypted traffic.
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
